Figure S2. Ionic charge balance of AMS PM1 during KORUS-AQ over SMA. Here the ionic charge balance is 13

represented by scatterplots of 2*[SO42-] + [NO3-] and [NH4+] molar concentrations at the surface KIST site (left) and on 14

the DC-8 aircraft (right). 2*[SO42-] + [NO3-] and [NH4+] are in charge balance, suggesting that AMS measured nitrate is 15

mainly inorganic nitrate that is associated with ammonium. 16
